qAndA.answer: The loop icon, which resembles a magnifying glass inside a circle, provides access to downloaded files.
qAndA.question: Which icon in GarageBand allows you to access your downloaded files?

qAndA.answer: He uses the "Split" function to divide the song into segments and then deletes the unwanted portions.
qAndA.question: How does Siva edit the song in GarageBand to isolate the desired ringtone section?

activities.description: Siva introduces himself and the topic of the video.
He outlines three previous methods for creating iPhone ringtones.
He highlights the new, simpler method introduced in iOS 13 using GarageBand.
He encourages viewers to subscribe to his channel and introduces the "Apple Bytes" series.

activities.description: Downloads a song using the Safari browser.
Locates the downloaded song in the "Files" app.
Starts a new project and imports the downloaded song.
Adjusts the song length and trims unwanted sections using split and delete functions.
Enables looping for the selected song section.
Extends the loop length to 30 seconds.
Saves the loop as a ringtone.
Navigates to the iPhone settings to confirm the new ringtone is available.
Encourages viewers to like, share, and subscribe.
